name: Zoom pulse (RS2)
description: A short punch-in on the reel picture at its moments (kills) or on the music's beats: the picture scales up to `scale` over inMs on a quarter sine and back over outMs on a quarter cosine (a zoompan over the joined reel, once in the filter graph; the sound is untouched). Pulses are at least 0.5 s apart (at most 2 per second) and never inside a join. Used by reel styles (D412) when the examples show zoom pulses; the size can be tuned in Settings > Clips > Reel styles. Not a flash: the brightness does not change. Flag reel-styles.
